empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable block of review instructions. Create one, or import a SKILL.md / .zip, then link it to agents on their Skills tab.

community.title: Search community skills
community.subtitle: Import vetted skills from public repos
community.mountBody: Searching vetted community skills ships in a later lesson. Until then, import a SKILL.md or a skill .zip via Add Skill → Import.

preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It is unlinked from every agent.
preview.importedNotice: Imported skill: these are someone else's instructions that will go straight into your agent's prompt. Read the body before enabling it.

editor.subtitle: A skill is text-only configuration: it is inserted into the prompt of every agent it is linked to.
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — the agent reads it to decide when the skill applies. Write it as a directive: "Use when [condition]. Flag [what]."
editor.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
What to check, how to judge severity, what to suggest…
editor.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
editor.mountBody: Mount point for {owner}. Eval cases for this skill are created and run by the eval pipeline.
editor.runOnEvalsHint: Available with the L06 eval pipeline

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a SKILL.md file or a skill .zip. Only the Markdown core is read; nothing in the archive is executed.
import.trustTitle: You are about to add someone else's instructions to your agents' prompts
import.trustBody: A skill is not data — it is instructions the model follows. Read the whole body below, edit anything you don't agree with, and only then save. The skill is saved disabled; enable it after vetting.

reason.not-core: not part of the skill core

import.saved: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you enable it.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.

stats.noAgents: No agent has this skill enabled yet — link it on an agent's Skills tab.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs with this skill in the last 30 days.
stats.footnote: Pull frequency = share of the linked agents' completed runs whose prompt included this skill. Accept rate = accepted / (accepted + dismissed) findings of runs that included it.
